name: Playground
thesis: The app is a playground: shape, color, and motion carry personality, but the next action is never ambiguous.
bestFor: Social, community, creative tools, kids, games, and hobby apps.

variants.name: Toy Box
variants.summary: A bright toy box: chunky blocks, primary colors, and big actions.
variants.signature: A sticker that peels up on tap.
variants.treatment: Large color blocks, chunky controls, rounded display type, and a generous layout.

variants.name: Sticker Album
variants.summary: A scrapbook: rotated cards, tape, and handwritten labels.
variants.signature: A rotated photo card with a tape strip.
variants.treatment: Layered cards, slight rotations, paper texture, and a dense collage rhythm.

variants.name: Arcade
variants.summary: A neon arcade: dark background, pixel accents, and high-score energy.
variants.treatment: Dark surfaces, a single neon accent, condensed type, and a compact vertical list.

signatureMoves: A sticker that peels up on tap.
A rotated photo card with a tape strip.
A color block that changes the mood of the screen.

platform.ios: Use SF Rounded and SF Symbols. Keep the system back gesture. Use a tab bar for peers and sheets for quick actions. Spring only on direct manipulation. Respect reduce motion.
platform.android: Use Roboto with rounded shapes and Material Symbols. Edge-to-edge. Use a NavigationBar for three to five peers, or a FAB menu for 2-6 related create actions. Respect the system animation scale.

principles: Color blocks are structure, not wallpaper.
Motion is a reaction, not a loop.
The primary action is still obvious.
avoid: Every card rotated and every button pill-shaped.
A gradient behind text with no contrast check.
Five equal tabs because the template had five.

items.title: Rooftop drawing
items.body: Bring a notebook and a jacket

screens.home: A playful composition of one large color block, a crew strip, and two or three plan cards with real times. The primary action is a chunky button or FAB, not a hidden gesture.
screens.detail: A plan detail: who is going, when, where, what to bring, and one join/leave action. Use avatars or initials, not fake testimonial photos.
screens.compose: A quick plan composer: what, when, where, who. Keep it to one screen with large controls and a visible create state.
screens.profile: A playful profile: avatar, crew, recent plans, and a few real stats. No invented follower counts.

components.button: Chunky 12-20pt radius, bold label, high contrast. Pills only for tags and filters.
components.list: Color-block cards with 16-24pt radius and one clear action. Do not put a card inside a card.
components.input: Large, friendly fields with clear labels and a visible focus state.
components.navigation: Tab bar with three to five peers, or a FAB menu for related create actions. Do not mix both.
